== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Lirial]] crystal, also referred to as [[Lirial]] [[stone]], is a versatile and rare material used for various magical functions within the territory of [[Lirial]]. It serves as a primary medium for gathering and preserving information, often appearing in forms such as scrying lenses, communication devices, or recording stones. These specialized crystals can be crafted to observe and document specific locations through gates, though some versions are single-use and require significant time and rare materials to produce. In addition to surveillance, the material can manifest as floating spheres or globes used for shepherding people. Beyond information gathering, the crystal possesses defensive and restrictive properties. It can be used to encase targets in solid, translucent rock or create prisons of crystal that lock subjects in place without piercing them. The material is also used to [[construct]] weapons, such as javelins adorned with whirling crystals or hammers. Furthermore, the crystal is deeply connected to the essence of [[Lirial]] itself; it can function as a key to open gates, and the physical form of the [[Lirial Incarnation]] is composed of white crystal and silver wire.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Lirial]] crystal serves as a medium for [[Leah]] to communicate with [[Simon]]. These communication crystals, also referred to as [[Lirial]] stones, can manifest as flying objects. In one instance, a marble-sized glassy crystal passed through a door. Generally, these crystals appear as hovering globes that resemble floating balls of mirrored glass.}}
